chapter: The Dallas nightclub and Jesse Stone's band
title: St. Joseph, Missouri: Stone's background and Coleman Hawkins
summary: Blue Serenaders was Coleman Hawkins's first band; Stone came from Atchison, Kansas; fourteen men crowd two rooms in the Charlotte Hotel.

bands.name: Jesse Stone and His Blue Serenaders

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What town were you out of?
Well, we were now working at Saint, Joseph, Missouri, because he said, 'I have to take you there because the guy that used to book my old band will remember me, and maybe we can pick up some work.'
I seem to remember somebody else coming from Saint, Joe, Missouri.

Well, I'll tell you, Jesse Stone had a band there before, and they were the Blue Serenaders. This is the first band Coleman Hawkins ever played in, with Jesse Stone. Coleman Hawkins is from Saint, Joseph, Missouri. And his whole family, and all of them play the piano, and were beautiful musicians, his whole family.
But where was Jesse Stone really from?

Jesse Stone is from Atchison, Kansas, which is 32 miles away from Saint Joseph, Missouri. And on the way between -- see, Jesse Stone, Jesse Stone's family was with a medicine show, his father and grandfather. So his grandfather had a farm in Atchison, Kansas, and we visited his farm, and on the way to the farm there was one of Jesse James' caves that we used to go in and see, between Atchison and Saint Joseph, Missouri.

But anyway, we had this band. Now when we came into Saint Joseph, Missouri with this band, after we had gotten rid of T. Holder, we checked into the Charlotte Hotel, which is a black hotel owned by a woman that Jesse Stone knew, and she gave us two rooms. We had fourteen pieces, so there was seven to a room. The first three or four that hit the bed could sleep in that. The rest of us had to kind of stick on the floor and in the chairs.
